Name: Dominic de Guzmán
Summary: Spanish priest who founded the Order of Preachers, the Dominicans, confirmed in 1216.
Contribution: His order joined preaching, study and poverty, sending trained preachers to towns and universities and shaping Catholic theology and pastoral work for centuries.
Testimony: He devoted his life to preaching truth with humility, believing that preachers must first live and study what they proclaim.
